title: Execution Graph
description: Defines execution graphs that prove multi-layer participation in the agentics contract system. Each graph represents a complete execution flow with nodes representing individual capability invocations across layers.

execution_id.description: Unique identifier for this execution instance

nodes.description: Array of execution nodes representing capability invocations

layer_participation.description: Proof of participation for each required layer in the execution

graph_metadata.description: Additional metadata about the execution graph

LayerType.description: The architectural layer in the agentics stack

ExecutionStatus.description: The execution status of a node

ExecutionNode.description: Represents a single capability execution within the graph

node_id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the execution graph

layer.description: The architectural layer this node belongs to

capability.description: The capability identifier that was invoked

service.description: The service or repository that executed this capability

version.description: Semantic version of the service that executed

timestamp.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this node was executed

status.description: The execution status of this node

dependencies.description: Array of node_ids that this node depends on

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the node output for verification

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the node input for verification

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if status is 'failed'

LayerParticipationEntry.description: Participation proof for a single layer

executed.description: Whether this layer was executed during the graph processing

services.description: List of services from this layer that participated

node_ids.description: Node IDs from this layer that were executed

first_execution.description: Timestamp of first execution in this layer

last_execution.description: Timestamp of last execution in this layer

LayerParticipation.description: Proof object demonstrating which layers participated in execution

foundational.description: Participation from the foundational layer (e.g., foundation-agentic)

intelligence.description: Participation from the intelligence layer (e.g., LLM services)

core.description: Participation from the core layer (e.g., core capabilities)

integration_infra.description: Participation from the integration and infrastructure layers

apex.description: Participation from the apex layer (e.g., apex-agentic)

GraphMetadata.description: Additional metadata about the execution graph

total_nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the graph

executed_nodes.description: Number of nodes that were executed

skipped_nodes.description: Number of nodes that were skipped

critical_path_ms.description: Duration of the critical path in milliseconds

parallelism_factor.description: Ratio of total work to critical path (measure of parallelism achieved)

graph_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the entire graph for integrity verification
